title: Author Atomic Lease Claim and Contention Tests
instructions: Append after the previous chunk without editing earlier lines. Write physical pytest cases (real SQLite WAL files, real threads; no mock objects): test_ch04_fr_002_* for SRS-412-04-FR-002 (Worker daemons shall claim tasks exclusively using atomic `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transactions with lease expiration updates.); test_ch04_fr_003_* for SRS-412-04-FR-003 (The default task lease duration shall be strictly 1800 seconds (30 minutes).); test_ch04_claim_next_task_* for INTERFACE:claim_next_task (claim_next_task(db_path: str, daemon_id: str, lease_sec: int = 1800) -> dict[str, Any] | None.); test_ch04_nfr_tm_01_* for NFR-TM-01 (Atomic lease acquisition latency shall be less than 5 milliseconds under concurrent 10-daemon contention.); test_ch04_nfr_tm_03_* for NFR-TM-03 (Zero duplicate claims shall occur under any concurrency load.). Section 9 obligations: Unit test verifies `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` prevents double claims across concurrent threads.
